description_en: Thehiticame to be known as Gũ Bāhāḥ Hiti, as it was established to provide water for the daily rituals at Gũ Bāhāḥ, which is the old name of Jogeśvara Mandira (SKH0510).Above the three spouts of thishiti, facing south, are small niches housing statues: Gaṇeśa above the western spout, Ardhanārīśvara above the central spout, and Kumāra above the eastern spout.Ajaḥdhuṃis installed on either side of the hiti. Additionally, statues of the Buddha and Umāmaheśvara can be observed, along with twocaityas, within the premises of thehiti.Thishitiwas established in 1168 CE (NS 288) during the reign of King Rudradeva. It was commissioned by an individual in memory of his deceased mother, father, and son. Unfortunately, the sponsor’s name is unclear due to the breakage of the inscription that records this event.Additionally, there is a broken piece of another conduit west of thehiti, with an inscription indicating that it was constructed by a person, along with his wife Bhuvaneśvarī and son Raṇavīrasiṃ, in 1705 CE (NS 825). This suggests the existence of anotherhitiat the Gũ Bāhāḥ premises.Water from the central spout is used for the daily worship at Jogeśvara Mandira. Every morning, the priest bathes at the spout and collects water for worship. However, water flows from this conduit only during the rainy season. Consequently, a separate pipe has been affixed to the conduit to enable water stored in a tank to flow, facilitating the priest's bathing rituals and providing water for worship throughout the year.
description_ne: साँखुको गुँ बाहाः क्षेत्रमा रहेको जोगेश्वर मन्दिर (SKH0510) को उत्तरमा गुँ बाहाः हिति रहेको छ । जोगेश्वर मन्दिरको पुरानो नाम गुँ बाहाः हो । गुँ बाहाःमा नित्यपूजा गर्दा चाहिने पानीको निम्ति बनाइएको हिति हुनाले यसलाई गुँ बाहाः हिति भनिएको हो । यहाँ दक्षिणाभिमुख गरी तीनवटा टुटी बनाइएका छन् । पश्चिमपट्टिको टुटीमाथि गणेश, बीचको टुटीमाथि अर्धनारीश्वर र पूर्वपट्टिको टुटीमाथि कुमार स्थापना गरिएको छ । हितिको दायाँबायाँ एक-एकवटा जःधुं पनि राखिएका छन् । हिति वरिपरि बुद्धका मूर्तिहरू, दुईवटा चैत्य र उमामहेश्वर पनि स्थापना गरिएका छन् ।यो हिति नेसं २८८ (सन् ११६८) मा राजा रुद्रदेवको शासनकालमा स्थापना गरिएको थियो । दिवंगत आमा, बुबा र छोराको स्मरणमा कुनै व्यक्तिले हिति स्थापना गरेका थिए । शिलापत्र जीर्ण भएकोले संस्थापकको नाम थाहा हुनसकेन । हितिको पश्चिमपट्टि कुनै हितिको टुक्रा रहेको छ । त्यसमा कुँदिएको अभिलेख अनुसार नेसं ८२५ (सन् १७०५) मा कुनै दाताले पत्नी भुवनेश्वरी र छोरा रणवीरसिंसँग मिलेर त्यो हिति निर्माण गरेका थिए । यसबाट गुँ बाहाः परिसरमा अर्को एउटा हिति पनि अस्तित्वमा थियो भन्ने संकेत गर्छ ।हितिमा रहेका तीनवटा टुटीमध्ये बीचको टुटी (SKH0520-002) सांस्कृतिक दृष्टिले महत्वपूर्ण रहेको छ । जोगेश्वर मन्दिरमा नित्यपूजा गर्दा त्यसै टुटीको पानी प्रयोग गर्नुपर्ने परम्परा छ । प्रत्येक दिन बिहान पूजारीले त्यही टुटीमा स्नान गरेर नित्यपूजाको लागि त्यही टुटीबाट झरेको पानी लग्नुपर्ने परम्परा छ । तर हितिको मुहान सुक्दै गएपछि वर्षायाममा मात्र त्यस टुटीबाट पानी झर्ने गर्छ । त्यसैले ट्याङ्कीको पाइप हालेर भएपनि त्यसै टुटीबाट झर्ने पानी प्रयोग गरी पूजारीले स्नान गर्ने एवं जोगेश्वर र वज्रयोगिनी मन्दिरमा नित्यपूजा भइरहेको छ ।

historical_events.event_description: Thishitiwas established in 1168 CE (NS 288) during the reign of King Rudradeva. Water spouts were installed in memory of the sponsor's deceased mother, father, and son. Unfortunately, the sponsor's name is unclear due to the breakage of the inscription that records this event.
Seven family members, including Samundaya and Vāsiṃha, installed the Buddha statue in memory of a deceased family member.
Together with his wife Bhuvaneśvarī and son Raṇavīrasiṃha, a donor offered a beam support for a bell. The name of the main donor and the bell for which the support was installed are both unclear.

historical_events.event_name: Construction of a rest house and installation of a Gaṇeśa statue
historical_events.event_description: Aphalcā, featuring a statue of Gaṇeśa, was constructed with the wish for the emancipation of Saṃgrāma Siṃha and Mayaju Thakuṃ of Kathmandu.
The Akṣobhya statue was erected by the family in memory of the late Rājeśa Vajrācārya.
